title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.media.sideload_url tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #16, §1.5). media.sideload_url is MUTATING (class M, idempotentHint — deduped by _elementor_source_image_hash; proxied-to-REST POST elementor-ultra/v1/media/sideload). It does NOT touch a page document — it imports ONE small external image into the media library; the dedupe makes repeated smokes a no-op, and the driver trashes the returned attachment_id in teardown so the library is left clean. No v4/Pro gate (media works on free Elementor), so it runs UNCONDITIONALLY. MINIMAL valid input per §1.5: REQUIRED `url` (alt/title optional); we point at a tiny stable picsum image (1x1-ish) + an `alt` so a11y is clean. The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {attachment_id, url, sizes, deduped}.
